name: Mimetas OrganoPlate Graft 6401-400-B 384 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes:
Dimensions are in meters. Registered on the plate's 384-well microtitre lattice, which is what the rows/columns/pitch schema expresses and what a full-coverage acquisition mode needs to reach every chip; the chip lattice is described below but is not what this file's grid encodes.

CONTROLLING DOCUMENT. MIMETAS drawing 'Graft (6401-400-B)', REV. D, dated 2025-04-29, scale 1:1, unit mm, designed by F. Schavemaker, checked and approved by B. Trietsch, marked '- Confidential-'. Supplied as '20250429_Graft (6401-400-B) Technical Drawing Rev_D.pdf'. The sheet mixes period and comma decimal separators (e.g. '127.80+/-0,2'). This drawing is confidential and is not published by MIMETAS; it is on file at Ramona Optics (Slack DM, 2026-09-15, forwarded by Jarrett Bliton for the GSK demo) rather than online. web_reference therefore points at the MIMETAS product page, which is the highest-authority PUBLIC document; the product specification flyer for 6401-400-B was also read and is cited below.

FROM THE DRAWING, as dimensioned callouts: outer_plate_dimensions.length 127.80 +/- 0.2 mm; width 85.50 +/- 0.2 mm; height 14.4 +/- 0.1 mm (overall plate height, Section A-A; no lid is shown or dimensioned on the drawing). alignment_reference.offset_from_left_edge 12.1 +/- 0.05 mm and offset_from_top_edge 9 +/- 0.05 mm, both taken off the outer plate edges in the Top View; the drawing carries no datum symbols and never labels a well 'A1', so A1 is taken to be the corner well nearest those two edges. well_dimensions.pitch 4.50 mm. The drawing prints 127.80 x 85.50, not the ANSI/SLAS 4-2004 nominal 127.76 x 85.48; the drawing's numbers are used here. Note the plate is NOT a 127.76 footprint with a 12.13/8.99 A1 -- the vendor's own values are close to but not the standard's.

SCALED OFF THE DRAWING, not dimensioned: well_dimensions.diameter 0.0036 m is the top opening of the rounded-square microtitre well, flat-to-flat. MIMETAS does not dimension the well opening on any of the three OrganoPlate drawings. It was measured off the 1:1 vector geometry three times and independently: 3.61 mm on 4004-400-B Rev F (1200 dpi raster, calibrated on the 4.50 mm pitch), 3.65 mm on 6405-400-B Rev E and 3.68 mm on 6401-400-B Rev D (PDF path coordinates, calibrated on the 127.80 mm footprint; those two are stroke-centreline, inside-of-stroke gives 3.55 and 3.58). All three close on the pitch against the measured rib between openings (3.61 + 0.89 = 4.50). 0.0036 m is the rounded consensus. The rounded-square corner radius is about 0.5 mm, also scaled and not dimensioned. The schema has no square field, so the flat-to-flat width is recorded in 'diameter' and 'shape' is 'square'; the Ø2.00 mm figure that appears on the drawings is the chip access aperture in the floor of the well, NOT the well opening, and must not be used as the diameter.

DERIVED: well_dimensions.depth 0.01159 m = 14.4 mm overall plate height minus 2.81 mm, the drawing's 'Distance to top of top glass', both measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt. The drawing does not dimension well depth. The derivation is corroborated by scaling the well wall height off Section A-A (1:1) at about 11.64 mm. bottom_shape 'flat' is from the depiction in Section A-A -- tapered (draft) walls standing on a flat laminate floor -- and is not stated as a note.

BOTTOM THICKNESS AND WORKING DISTANCE. This is the number that decides whether the objective can focus. The drawing's note block, all measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt: 'Glass substrate thickness: .15' (150 um, 1H coverslip thickness per the flyer); 'Microfluidics height: .22'; 'Distance to bottom glass 2.29'; 'Distance to focal plane: 2.44'; 'Distance to top of top glass: 2.81'. The stack closes: 2.29 + 0.15 = 2.44, so the focal plane is the top surface of the 150 um bottom glass, i.e. 2.44 mm above the plate underside. Materials per the flyer: top plate virgin polystyrene, bottom plate optical quality 150 um glass, microfluidics glass and proprietary polymers. The drawing itself says only 'Glass substrate' with no grade.

CHIP LAYOUT. 64 tissue culture chips, 8 chip-rows x 8 chip-columns, counted off the Bottom View. Each chip spans a 2 well-row x 3 well-column block (chip cell 13.50 x 9.00 mm) and the 64 chips tile the 16 x 24 lattice exactly, with no orphan positions. Per chip the drawing shows 'Ø2.00 (5x)' access wells plus a Ø1.00 mm opening at the lower-middle position -- the open-top grafting chamber, which is also the viewing position. That Ø1.00 feature is the one geometric difference from the 3-lane 64 chip, whose equivalent position has no aperture. The chip detail carries a 2.5 mm dimension where the 3-lane 64 carries 2.2 mm. All 384 openings are moulded identically.

NOT AVAILABLE FROM ANY DOCUMENT READ: footprint corner radius, skirt/flange height, lid height, plate colour, surface treatment, sterility statement, and well volumes (the flyer gives medium volume 50 uL recommended per well, 15-90 uL possible, and ECM-gel loading volume 2.0 uL, which are working volumes rather than geometric ones).

OTHER DOCUMENTS READ: MIMETAS product specification flyer 'OrganoPlate Graft, Product code 6401-400-B' (2023). It states: SBS Standard 384 well plate; 64 chips; chip lattice 9.0 mm x 4.5 mm and the 2.5 mm chip dimension; perfusion channels 400 um, ECM 1800 um, grafting chamber 1000 um, channel height 220 um, PhaseGuide 55 um; bottom plate optical quality 150 um glass (1H coverslip thickness).

SIBLING PART NUMBERS in the same OrganoPlate family, not registered here: 4004-400-B (3-lane 40), 6405-400-B (3-lane 64), 6401-400-B (Graft), 9603-400-B (2-lane 96). All share the 127.80 x 85.50 x 14.4 mm 384-well top and differ in the microfluidic layer.

DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN VENDOR DOCUMENTS: the Graft flyer's text says 'A single chip is connected to 7 wells of the OrganoPlate in a 3x3 well grid, with the central well providing a grafting chamber and viewing access'. That cannot be right for this plate -- 64 chips on 3 x 3 blocks would need a 24 x 24 lattice, and the flyer's OWN chip diagram on the same page is dimensioned 9.0 mm x 4.5 mm, i.e. a 2 x 3 block. Drawing Rev D agrees with the diagram: 8 x 8 chips of 2 x 3 positions. The '3x3 / 7 wells' sentence appears to be copied from the 3-lane 40 flyer and is treated here as a vendor error. The flyer's 'SBS Standard 384 well plate' also sits against the drawing's 127.80 x 85.50 rather than the standard's 127.76 x 85.48. The drawing wins in this file.

PUBLIC DIMENSIONED DRAWING, AND A REVISION DISCREPANCY. web_reference is MIMETAS' 'OrganoPlate Graft Automated Tissue Placement' protocol V1.0, whose page 4 is a titled dimensioned drawing 'OrganoPlate Graft dimensions' (Top View, section A-A 1:1, detail B 10:1) and whose page 5 carries the Microfluidic Chip detail and a plate layout drawn as rows A-P x columns 1-24 with chip outlines spanning 2 rows x 3 columns, 8 x 8 = 64 chips. That public drawing agrees with the confidential Rev D on 127.80+/-0,2, 85.50+/-0,2, 14.4+/-0.1, 12.1+/-0.05, 9+/-0.05, glass substrate .15 and microfluidics height .22, and it independently confirms that A1 is the corner well nearest the 12.1 and 9 datums and that rows are the 16 axis. IT DISAGREES ON THE Z STACK: the public V1.0 drawing prints 'Distance to focal plane: 2.53', 'Distance to bottom glass 2.38' and 'Distance to top of top glass: 2.90', where Rev D prints 2.44, 2.29 and 2.81 -- a 0.09 mm shift of the whole stack. Rev D (2025-04-29) is the later document and is followed here, which is why depth is 14.4 - 2.81 = 11.59 mm rather than 14.4 - 2.90 = 11.50 mm. A reviewer who cares about the focal plane should note the two vendor values differ by 90 um, which is more than the 150 um glass is thick. The MIMETAS files/ tree is dead since their 2025 site move, so the citation is a Wayback id_ capture; the live product page is https://www.mimetas.com/en/organoplate-graft/ . US patent 10,532,355 B2 (MIMETAS B.V.) independently states the 4.5 mm 384-well pitch.
